children: Firan Technology Group shares surged Thursday morning after the company reported higher earnings and revenue on the back of ramping up defense deliveries.

The Canadian aerospace and defense electronics product supplier late Wednesday reported a 34% increase in revenue to C$64.1 million ($45 million) for the third quarter, topping analyst forecasts of a more modest rise to C$52.3 million.
The company's circuits segment saw revenue grow to C$45.1 million from C$32.1 million. Its aerospace unit generated C$19.8 million, up from C$16.8 million a year earlier.
The higher revenue supported a rise in net earnings, which rose to C$10 million from C$2.8 million.
On an adjusted basis, earnings came to C$0.41 a share, more than double the C$0.18 a share expected by analysts, according to FactSet.
"We exceeded the record financial performances just set last quarter and we saw continued operational improvements at many Circuits and Aerospace sites," said Chief Executive Brad Bourne.
